DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どの証明書をご希望ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 住民票の写しを二通取りたいです。提出先が二つあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二提出先用の住民票二通を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Two copies of my resident record. I have two places to submit them.
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request two resident-record copies for two recipients. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 提出先から、載せる項目の指定はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have the recipients specified which details to include?

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一方はこの案内があります。もう一方は必要な項目を確認していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 片方指定あり片方未確認を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: One has these instructions. I haven't checked the required details with the other.
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain one has specifications and the other is unchecked. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 項目をご確認いただいてから、申請できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can apply after checking the details.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 案内のある方の一通を、先に申請します。もう一通は提出先へ聞いてからにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 指定済一通だけ先申請を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll apply first for the one with instructions. I'll ask the other recipient before applying for the second.
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose to apply first for only the specified copy. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、今回の申請欄は一通でご記入ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then enter one copy in this application.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一通と書きました。この案内の項目が選べているか見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 一通記入し項目照合を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've written one. Please check that I've selected the details in these instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Write one copy and request comparison of selected details. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 案内と記入欄を確認します。受取時にも記載をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll compare the instructions and form. Check the contents when collecting too.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 受け取ったら指定の項目を見ます。残りは確認後に改めて申請します。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受取項目確認と残り後申請を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check the specified details on collection. I'll apply for the remainder separately after confirming.
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check collected details and apply later for the remaining copy. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承りました。それでは、交付窓口へご案内します。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I'll show you to the issuance counter. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 本日は面会にいらしたのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're here for a visit today.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。父と昔のアルバムを見たいので、机のある場所を使えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 父とのアルバム面会に机を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I'd like to look at an old album with my father. May we use somewhere with a table?
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request a table for an album visit with your father. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの面会室の机をご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can show you a table in this visiting room.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。アルバムが大きいので、二人が隣に座れる席がよいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 大判アルバムのため隣席を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Thank you. The album is large, so we'd prefer seats next to each other.
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Request adjacent seats for a large album. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらなら隣にお座りいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can sit beside each other here.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この席でお願いします。父は眼鏡を使うので、職員の方に持ってきてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 席を選び父の眼鏡準備を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: This seat, please. My father uses glasses; could a staff member bring them?
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose the seats and request your father's glasses. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お父様へお尋ねして、眼鏡をご用意します。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll ask your father and prepare his glasses.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 助かります。最初のページが家の写真なので、そこを開いて待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家写真の初ページを開いて待つと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: That helps. The first page shows our house, so I'll open it there and wait.
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Open the first house-photo page while waiting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お父様がいらっしゃいました。面会の終了時刻はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Your father is here. This is the visiting end time.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 時刻を確認しました。まず家の写真を一緒に見て、時間内にアルバムをしまいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 終了時刻を確認し写真閲覧と収納を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've checked the time. We'll start with the house photo and put the album away before time is up.
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the end time and plan viewing and putting away the album. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞお二人でゆっくりお過ごしください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please enjoy your time together. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通帳についてのお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your question about a passbook?

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この通帳の見本で、この短い文字が何を示すか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 見本通帳の短縮文字を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to know what this abbreviation in the sample passbook means.
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about abbreviated text in a sample passbook. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この欄は摘要です。こちらの一覧と見比べられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: This field is the transaction description. You can compare it with this list.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 摘要という欄なのですね。金額の左と右は、入金と出金を分けていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 摘要名と入出金左右を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it's the description field. Do the left and right amount columns separate deposits and withdrawals?
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask the description field name and left-right deposits and withdrawals. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この見本では、左が出金、右が入金です。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: In this sample, left is withdrawals and right is deposits.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 右側の金額が増えた分ですね。同じ日に二行ある時も、別々の取引として読みますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 入金側確認と同日二行の意味を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: The right amount is what was added, then. If there are two lines on one day, should I read them as separate transactions too?
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the deposit side and ask about two lines on the same date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、この見本では一行ずつ表示しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, this sample shows each transaction on its own line.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一行ずつ読めました。最後の欄は、その取引後の残高ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 一行読解後最後残高欄を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can read them one line at a time now. Is the last column the balance after that transaction?
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: After reading each line, ask about the final balance column. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そうです。日付、摘要、金額、残高の順に見られます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Read date, description, amount and balance in that order.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 四つの欄を順に見ます。右側に金額がある行から、もう一度読み直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 四欄の順を理解し入金行を読む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll read the four columns in order. I'll reread starting from a line with an amount on the right.
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Understand the four-column order and read a deposit line. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ一覧もお使いください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SUITA-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please use the list too. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日は苗を各列へ運んでください。
DLG-SC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please carry the seedlings to each row today.

DLG-SC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 初めてなので、どの列から配ればよいか教えてください。
DLG-SC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 苗を配る開始列を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's my first time, so please tell me which row to start distributing from.
DLG-SC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask which row starts seedling distribution. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 赤い札の列からです。一列につき二束を置きます。
DLG-SC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-001-SHARED-03.translation: Start with the red-tagged rows. Put two bundles per row.

DLG-SC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 赤い札から二束ずつですね。先に全部運ぶより、二列分ずつ運びたいです。
DLG-SC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 赤札二束ずつと二列分ずつ運ぶ希望を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-001-SHARED-04.translation: Two bundles each starting at red, then. Rather than carry them all first, I'd like to carry two rows' worth at a time.
DLG-SC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm two bundles for red and request carrying two rows at a time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それで構いません。苗を置く位置はこちらです。
DLG-SC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-001-SHARED-05.translation: That's fine. This is where to put the seedlings.

DLG-SC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 道の端に置くのですね。今の四束で、最初の二列分になります。
DLG-SC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 端の置場と四束で二列分を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-001-SHARED-06.translation: At the path edge, then. These four bundles cover the first two rows.
DLG-SC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm edge placement and four bundles for two rows. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。次の列は黄色い札ですが、そちらは一束だけです。
DLG-SC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. The next rows have yellow tags, and they need only one bundle each.

DLG-SC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 黄色は一束ですね。赤の列が終わってから、数を変えます。
DLG-SC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 黄色札は一束に切り替えると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-001-SHARED-08.translation: One for yellow. I'll change the quantity after finishing the red rows.
DLG-SC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Switch to one bundle for yellow tags. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今日は赤が四列、黄色が二列あります。
DLG-SC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-001-SHARED-09.translation: There are four red rows and two yellow rows today.

DLG-SC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 全部で十束ですね。残り六束を、札の色に合わせて配ります。
DLG-SC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 四赤二黄から十束と計算し残六束を配る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-001-SHARED-10.translation: Ten bundles in total, then. I'll distribute the remaining six according to tag color.
DLG-SC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Calculate ten from four red and two yellow rows and distribute the remaining six. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お願いします。配り終えたら今日はここまでです。お疲れさまでした。
DLG-SC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please do. Once distributed, that's all for today. Thank you for your work.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 桃をご覧になっていますね。

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 今夜食べる物と、二日後に食べる物を一つずつほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 今夜と二日後用の桃を各一個希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'd like one to eat tonight and one to eat in two days.
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Request one peach for tonight and one for two days later. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 柔らかさの違う物があります。こちらでお選びしてよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: We have different firmness levels. May I choose for you?

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: お願いします。自分で押すと傷みそうなので、食べる日の違いを伝えて選んでもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 食べる日をもとに店員の選別を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Please. I might damage them by pressing, so I'd like you to choose based on when I'll eat them.
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Request staff selection based on eating dates. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 今夜用はこちら、こちらは少し硬めです。置き方も袋に添えてご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: This is for tonight, and this is a little firmer. We'll include storage guidance with the bags too.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 硬めの方に印を付けられますか。家で混ぜたくないです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 硬めの桃の識別印を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Could you mark the firmer one? I don't want to mix them up at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Request identification of the firmer peach. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 別の小袋に入れ、二日後用と書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'll put it in a separate small bag marked for two days later.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 助かります。二つを持ち帰る間につぶれないよう、箱に入れてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 小袋の区別を保ち持帰用箱を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: That helps. Please put the two in a box so they don't get crushed on the way home.
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Keep the small-bag distinction and request a take-home box. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 小箱へ並べました。合計六百円です。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: I've placed them in a small box. Six hundred yen total.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-02-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-02-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 六百円払います。袋の文字を見て、今夜用から食べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-02-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 代金を払い表示を見て今夜用から食べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-02-001-SHARED-1.translation: I'll pay six hundred. I'll read the bag labels and start with tonight's peach.
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-02-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Pay and use the labels to eat tonight's peach first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-02-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-02-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: ありがとうございました。おいしく召し上がってください。

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: ご予約のお弁当は三つですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Your reserved boxed meals are three, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい。二つは今持って行き、残り一つは同僚が十二時に受け取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 予約三弁当の二個即受取と一個後受取を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes. I'll take two now, and my coworker will collect the remaining one at twelve.
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain immediate collection of two and later collection of one among three reserved meals. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 分けてお渡しするので、それぞれのお名前を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Since we'll hand them over separately, please give each name.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 今の二つは山田、十二時の一つは佐藤です。佐藤にも予約番号を伝えています。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 各受取人の名前と番号共有を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: The two now are Yamada, and the one at twelve is Sato. I've given Sato the reservation number too.
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Give each collector's name and explain number sharing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 山田様の二つは、同じ袋でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: May Yamada's two go in one bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 一つずつお願いします。別々の場所へ届けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 二個は別の配送先なので別袋を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: One bag each, please. They'll go to different locations.
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Request separate bags for two different delivery locations. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 二袋にしました。お支払いは三つまとめてなさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: I've made two bags. Will you pay for all three together?

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい、私がまとめて払います。佐藤の分は支払い済みと伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 三個の一括支払と同僚分支払済み連絡を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes, I'll pay for all. Please tell Sato that their meal is paid for.
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Pay for three together and request notice that the coworker's portion is prepaid. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 承りました。こちらが三つ分の領収書です。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Certainly. Here is the receipt for three.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-03-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-03-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 受け取りました。佐藤には、十二時に名前と番号を伝えて受け取るよう連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-03-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 領収書を受け取り同僚への受取案内を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-03-001-SHARED-1.translation: I've received it. I'll tell Sato to give their name and number at twelve to collect it.
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-03-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Receive the receipt and explain collection instructions for your coworker. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-03-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-03-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: では、残り一つは十二時にご用意します。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-03-001-SHARED-1.translation: Then we'll prepare the remaining one for twelve. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: ATMのご利用についてお尋ねでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Are you asking about using the ATM?

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 硬貨を預けたいのですが、この機械には入れる所が見当たりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 硬貨投入口が見当たらないと尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'd like to deposit coins, but I can't find anywhere to insert them on this machine.
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask about the missing coin slot. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この機械は紙幣のお取り扱いです。硬貨の入金は窓口へご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: This machine handles banknotes. Please consult the counter for coin deposits.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: そうですか。袋に入れた硬貨を持っています。数えた金額も伝えた方がいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 硬貨袋と数えた金額を伝える必要を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: I see. I have coins in a bag. Should I also tell them the amount I've counted?
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask about providing the coin bag and counted amount. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 窓口で金額とお持ちの口座をお伺いします。取り扱い条件はそこでご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: The counter will ask the amount and your account. We'll explain handling conditions there.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 通帳があります。今日は硬貨の預け入れだけで、紙幣を引き出す予定はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 通帳所持と硬貨入金のみの用件を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: I have my passbook. Today is only a coin deposit; I don't plan to withdraw banknotes.
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Mention your passbook and that you only want a coin deposit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 承知しました。入金の受付はこちらの番号札です。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Understood. This is the numbered ticket for deposit reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 入金の番号札を取りました。袋を開けずに、そのまま持って行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 入金番号札を取り袋のまま持参すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: I've taken a deposit ticket. I'll take the bag as it is without opening it.
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Take the deposit number and keep coins in their bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 窓口でお出しいただく時にご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: We'll guide you when you present it at the counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-04-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-04-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 分かりました。数えた金額のメモと通帳を用意して、呼ばれるのを待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-04-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 金額メモと通帳を用意し窓口相談を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-04-001-SHARED-1.translation: Understood. I'll prepare my note of the counted amount and passbook and wait to be called.
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-04-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Prepare amount notes and passbook and wait for counter consultation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-04-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-04-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: では、窓口でご相談ください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-04-001-SHARED-1.translation: Then please consult at the counter. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 展示場所の下見でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Are you inspecting an exhibition space?

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 来月、絵を三枚展示したいです。横に並べられるか見に来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 三枚の絵の横並び展示を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'd like to exhibit three paintings next month. I've come to see whether they can hang side by side.
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Discuss side-by-side display of three paintings. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こちらのパネルをご利用いただく案です。一枚の額はどのくらいの幅ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: One proposal is this panel. How wide is each frame?

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 四十センチです。絵の間は十センチほど空けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 額幅四十と間隔十を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Forty centimeters. I'd like about ten centimeters between paintings.
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: State forty-centimeter frames and ten-centimeter gaps. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 三枚と間二つで、百四十センチになりますね。このパネルは百八十センチです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Three frames and two gaps make one hundred forty centimeters. This panel is one hundred eighty.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: それなら左右にも余裕があります。机を前に置いて紹介文も配れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 幅の余裕を確認し紹介文配布机を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Then there's room at both sides too. Can I put a table in front to distribute introductions?
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Check spare width and ask about an introductory-handout table. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 机の位置は展示の担当者と決めます。通路を見ながら、この図へ希望を書いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Decide table placement with the exhibition staff. Considering the passage, mark your preference on this diagram.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 紹介文の机は端に描きます。絵の正面には置かない方が見やすそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 机を端に置く希望を図示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'll draw the introduction table at the end. Keeping it out of the paintings' front seems easier for viewing.
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Draw the preferred table position at the edge. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 図をお預かりして、担当者へお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'll take the diagram and pass it to the staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-05-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-05-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。額の写真も添えるので、配置を相談する時に使ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-05-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 額写真を添え担当者の配置相談へ渡す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-05-001-SHARED-1.translation: Thank you. I'll attach frame photos too; please use them when discussing placement.
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-05-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Attach frame photos for staff layout consultation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-05-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-05-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 承りました。展示のご相談、お待ちしております。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-05-001-SHARED-1.translation: Certainly. We look forward to discussing your exhibition.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この道具についてご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Is your question about this tool?

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 写真では使い方が分かりません。どう動かしたのか説明を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 昔の道具の動かし方の説明を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: I can't tell its use from the photo. I'd like an explanation of how it moved.
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Request explanation of an old tool's movement. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 穀物を入れて、この部分を回して使いました。実演用の模型でお見せできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: People put grain inside and turned this part. I can show you with a demonstration model.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: お願いします。本物と模型の違いも知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 実演と本物模型の違いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Please. I'd like to know the differences between the original and model too.
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask for a demonstration and original-model differences. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 模型は小さく作っています。回る部分の仕組みは、見えるようにしてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: The model is smaller. We've made the rotating mechanism visible.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 中が見えますね。回すと下へ落ちる所まで、もう一度見せてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 出口までの動作の再実演を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: I can see inside. Could you show it again through the point where turning makes the contents fall below?
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Request another demonstration through the outlet stage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: ゆっくり動かします。こちらの出口をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'll move it slowly. Watch this outlet.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 分かりました。昔の人が何人で使っていたかも、資料に書いてありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 使う人数が資料にあるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: I understand. Do the materials also say how many people used it?
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask whether sources state the number of users. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 横の説明には、一人が回し、もう一人が材料を入れる作業が載っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: The description beside it shows one person turning and another adding material.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-06-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-06-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: その分担を読んでから、道具全体をもう一度見ます。動きを見たので形も分かりやすくなりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-06-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 作業分担を読み道具全体を再観察する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-06-001-SHARED-1.translation: I'll read that division of work and then view the whole tool again. Seeing the movement has made the shape easier to understand.
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-06-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Read the division of labor and inspect the whole tool again. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-06-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-06-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: ぜひご覧ください。ご見学ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-06-001-SHARED-1.translation: Please do. Thank you for visiting.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: お薬の説明で、気になる点はございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Do you have any concerns about the medicine explanation?

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この包装が開けにくいです。家では手に力が入りにくい時があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 包装を開けにくく手の力が弱い時があると相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: This packaging is hard to open. At home, sometimes I can't put much strength in my hands.
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Discuss difficult packaging and occasional weak hand grip. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: どの部分が難しいか、こちらで見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Could you show me which part is difficult here?

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この角をつまむ所です。今も滑って、うまく持てません。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 角が滑ってつまめないと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Pinching this corner. It slips now too, and I can't hold it well.
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Show the corner slipping and being hard to grip. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 使い方と、別の包装への対応が可能かを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'll check how to use it and whether different packaging is possible.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: お願いします。薬を自分で別の袋へ移す前に相談したいと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 自己移替え前に包装対応を相談したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Please. I thought I should ask before transferring the medicine into another bag myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Consult about packaging before transferring medicine yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 保管方法も一緒に説明します。今は、どこに置いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: We'll explain storage too. Where do you keep it now?

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 引き出しに置いています。説明があれば、家で読むために紙もほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 現保管場所を答え紙の説明を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: In a drawer. If there are instructions, I'd like them on paper to read at home too.
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Give current storage and request written instructions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 注意点を紙にまとめてお渡しします。対応については確認後にご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'll summarize precautions on paper. We'll explain packaging options after checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-07-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-07-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 紙を受け取って、包装の相談が終わってから持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-07-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 包装相談と紙受領後に持ち帰ると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-07-001-SHARED-1.translation: I'll receive the paper and finish the packaging consultation before taking it home.
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-07-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Take it home after packaging consultation and receiving written guidance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-07-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-07-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: では、こちらで包装の方法をご説明します。どうぞお大事に。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-TAKATSUKI-07-001-SHARED-1.translation: Then I'll explain the packaging method here. Take care of yourself.
